title: checklist / add-tasks / poll-option dialogs close as soon as the request is sent; a server refusal loses the typed content
trigger: Compose a checklist (or Add Tasks, or a poll Add Option), press Create; the driver call returns Ok(request) so the dialog is set to None at once; TDLib then rejects the send (e.g. restricted chat, slow mode, deleted message)
effect: The dialog and everything typed in it are gone; only a generic status note remains, there is no way to retry without retyping
fix: Keep the dialog in a Sending { request: RequestId } stage and close it only on the matching answer; return it to Editing on error
